switch 2 choose your game bundle console.name: Switch 2 Choose Your Game Bundle Console + Animal Crossing: New Horizons + More
switch 2 choose your game bundle console.description: Enjoy gaming at home or on the go with the Nintendo Switch 2 Choose Your Game Bundle. This bundle includes the Nintendo Switch 2 console along with a digital download code that can be redeemed for one compatible game, including Mario Kart World, Donkey Kong Bananza, or Pokémon Pokopia. Three play modes let you enjoy games in handheld, tabletop, or TV mode to match your preferred style of play.The Nintendo Switch 2 Choose Your Game Bundle includes redesigned Joy-Con 2 controllers with magnetic attachment, comfortable handling, mouse-style controls for supported games, and the dedicated C Button for quick access to GameChat. Built-in voice chat and game screen sharing make it easy to connect with friends using compatible features, while support for an optional compatible USB camera enables face-to-face communication.Inside the box are the Nintendo Switch 2 console, Joy-Con 2 Left and Right controllers, Nintendo Switch 2 Dock, AC Adapter, USB-C charging cable, Joy-Con 2 Grip, two Joy-Con 2 Straps, Ultra High Speed HDMI cable, and the Choose One digital game download code. tronsmart - q20 active noise cancelling.description: The Tronsmart Sounfii Q20 headphones feature advanced active noise cancellation that reduces 85% of ambient noise, enhancing your music experience in loud environments. With oversized 40mm dynamic drivers, they deliver rich sound and powerful bass. The memory foam earpads and 90° swiveling design ensure a comfortable fit. Enjoy up to 60 hours of playtime with ANC off and the option for wired mode. The headphones also provide crystal clear hands-free calling, a foldable design for portability, and customizable EQ settings via the Tronsmart App. Additionally, they can connect to two Bluetooth devices simultaneously for shared listening.
